`wigglescout` is an R library that allows you to calculate summary
values across bigWig files and BED files and visualize them in a
genomics-relevant manner. It is based on broadly used libraries such as
`rtracklayer` and `GenomicRanges`, among others for calculation, and
mostly `ggplot2` for visualization. You can look at the `DESCRIPTION`
file to get more information about all the libraries that make this one
possible.

There are also many other tools whose functionality overlaps a little or
much with `wigglescout`, but there was no single tool that included all
that I needed. The aim of this library is therefore not to replace any
of those tools, or to provide a silver-bullet solution to genomics data
analysis, but to provide a comprehensive, yet simple enough set of tools
focused on bigWig files that can be used entirely from the R environment
without switching back and forth across tools.

Other tools and libraries for akin purposes that you may be looking for
include: `deepTools`, `SeqPlots`, `bwtool`, `wiggletools`, and the list
is endless!

`wigglescout` allows you to summarize and visualize the contents of
bigWig files in two main ways:

- **Genome-wide**. Genome is partitioned on equally-sized bins and their
  aggregated value is calculated. Useful to get a general idea of the
  signal distribution without looking at specific places.
- **Across sets of *loci***. This can be either summarized categories,
  or individual values, as in genome-wide analyses.

`wigglescout` functionality is built in two layers. Names of functions
that calculate values over bigWig files start with `bw_`. These return
`GRanges` objects when possible, `data.frame` objects otherwise
(i.e. when values are summarized over some category, genomic location is
lost in this process).

On the other hand, functions that plot such values and that usually make
internal use of `bw_` functions, start with `plot_`.

## Installation

`wigglescout` is a package under active development. You can install it
from this repository. For this, you will need `remotes` to install it
(and `devtools` if you plan to work on it):

``` R
install.packages(c('devtools', 'remotes'))
```

Additionally, there was an issue in the past with installing
dependencies that come from `BioConductor` repository. This seems to
have been fixed now, but if you run into problems, I recommend
installing manually these dependencies before running the installation:

``` R
install.packages(('BiocManager'))
BiocManager::install(c('GenomeInfoDb', 'GenomicRanges', 'rtracklayer'))
```

Then you can install directly from this GitHub repository:

``` R
library(remotes)
remotes::install_github('cnluzon/wigglescout', build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

## Getting started

The vignettes or [online
documentation](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/) can give a
comprehensive overview of what is available in the package. You can
check the vignettes with `browseVignettes("wigglescout")`.

## Troubleshooting

**Q**: When running `install_github` I get the following error:

``` R
Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘GenomeInfoDb’ in loadNamespace(i, c(lib.loc, .libPaths()), versionCheck = vI[[i]]):
there is no package called ‘GenomeInfoDbData’
Error: package ‘GenomeInfoDb’ could not be loaded
Execution halted
```

**A**: This seemed to be a problem that came from installing
`Bioconductor` dependencies. A workaround is installing the
`BioConductor` packages manually:

``` R
if (!requireNamespace('BiocManager', quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages('BiocManager')

BiocManager::install(c('GenomeInfoDb', 'GenomicRanges', 'rtracklayer'))
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`bed_to_bw()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/bed_to_bw.md)
  : Parse a scored BED file and exports a bigWig file with given
  chromsizes
- [`build_bins()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/build_bins.md)
  : Build a unscored bins GRanges object.
- [`build_bins_bw()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/build_bins_bw.md)
  : Build a tiles GRanges out of a bigWig file on a given bin size.
- [`bw_bins()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/bw_bins.md)
  : Build a binned-scored GRanges object from a set of bigWig files
- [`bw_chr_coverage()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/bw_chr_coverage.md)
  : Calculate bigWig coverage per chromosome
- [`bw_global_coverage()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/bw_global_coverage.md)
  : Calculate bigWig global coverage.
- [`bw_heatmap()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/bw_heatmap.md)
  : Calculate heatmap matrix of a bigWig file over a GRanges or BED file
- [`bw_loci()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/bw_loci.md)
  : Score a bigWig file list and a BED file or GRanges object.
- [`bw_profile()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/bw_profile.md)
  : Calculate profile values of a bigWig file over a BED file.
- [`.aggregate_scores()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-aggregate_scores.md)
  : Aggregate scores of a GRanges object on a field
- [`.bw_ranges()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-bw_ranges.md)
  : Score a GRanges object against a BigWig file
- [`.calculate_bw_profile()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-calculate_bw_profile.md)
  : Calculate profile values of a bigWig file over GRanges object.
- [`.calculate_matrix_norm()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-calculate_matrix_norm.md)
  : Calculate a normalized heatmap matrix for a bigWig file over a BED
  file
- [`.calculate_stretch_matrix()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-calculate_stretch_matrix.md)
  : Calculate matrix for stretch mode
- [`.color_limits()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-color_limits.md)
  : Calculate color limits from a value matrix and provided parameters
- [`.colorscale()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-colorscale.md)
  : Summary heatmap colorscale.
- [`.convert_and_label_loci()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-convert_and_label_loci.md)
  : Internal processing of loci sets and labels.
- [`.density_body()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-density_body.md)
  : Density 2d histogram plot
- [`.fetch_bigwig()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-fetch_bigwig.md)
  : Make a BigWigFile object out of a path or an URL
- [`.filter_scatter_data()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-filter_scatter_data.md)
  : Filter scatterplot data with quantile threshold on both axes
- [`.filter_violin_data()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-filter_violin_data.md)
  : Filter violin plot data with quantile threshold
- [`.get_wrapper_parameter_values()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-get_wrapper_parameter_values.md)
  : Get matching parameters of a target function with current context
- [`.granges_left_join()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-granges_left_join.md)
  : GRanges left join operation
- [`.heatmap_body()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-heatmap_body.md)
  : Helper function for matrix heatmap plot
- [`.heatmap_lines()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-heatmap_lines.md)
  : Helper function for calculating guide lines and labels in heatmap
- [`.intersect_bw_and_granges()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-intersect_bw_and_granges.md)
  : Intersect a BigWig file over loci on a GRanges object
- [`.is_multiple_loci()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-is_multiple_loci.md)
  : Check if a variable contains a list of things or array of
  potentially file names
- [`.key_value_string()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-key_value_string.md)
  : Make a string out of a named list.
- [`.label_multiple_loci()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-label_multiple_loci.md)
  : Label loci with a list of labels
- [`.limited_size_caption_line()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-limited_size_caption_line.md)
  : Make a string out of a named list. Split into lines if too wide.
- [`.loci_length()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-loci_length.md)
  : Checks how many loci
- [`.loci_to_granges()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-loci_to_granges.md)
  : Processes a loci and returns a GRanges object. Removes anything that
  is not a name field
- [`.make_caption()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-make_caption.md)
  : Make a string to put as caption in verbose mode. Includes system
  date.
- [`.make_label_from_object()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-make_label_from_object.md)
  : Get a valid label
- [`.make_norm_file_label()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-make_norm_file_label.md)
  : Generate a human-readable normalization function string including
- [`.make_norm_label()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-make_norm_label.md)
  : Generate a human-readable normalization function string
- [`.match_seqnames()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-match_seqnames.md)
  : Match seqname lists and throws the relevant warning
- [`.multi_bw_ranges()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-multi_bw_ranges.md)
  : Intersect a list of bigWig files with a GRanges object
- [`.multi_bw_ranges_aggregated()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-multi_bw_ranges_aggregated.md)
  : Intersect a list of bigWig files with a GRanges object and aggregate
  by name
- [`.multi_bw_ranges_norm()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-multi_bw_ranges_norm.md)
  : Intersect a list of bigWig files with a GRanges object (with
  background)
- [`.multi_ranges_overlap()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-multi_ranges_overlap.md)
  : Calculate overlap of one GRanges with a main GRanges object
- [`.natural_sort_by_field()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-natural_sort_by_field.md)
  : Take a column of a data frame to use as row names, drop such column
  and reorder the data frame so row names follow natural order.
- [`.preprocess_heatmap_matrix()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-preprocess_heatmap_matrix.md)
  : Preprocess heatmap values for plotting
- [`.process_norm_mode()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-process_norm_mode.md)
  : Get a function out of a norm mode string.
- [`.profile_body()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-profile_body.md)
  : Helper function plots a profile from a dataframe
- [`.profile_breaks()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-profile_breaks.md)
  : Compute where the break ticks go in heatmap and profile
- [`.profile_labels()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-profile_labels.md)
  : Make profile labels
- [`.remove_top_by_mean()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-remove_top_by_mean.md)
  : Remove top loci in a GRanges column by mean of specified values
- [`.round_ignore_null()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-round_ignore_null.md)
  : Round a value. If it's NULL, returns NULL.
- [`.scatterplot_body()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-scatterplot_body.md)
  : Scatterplot of values in a GRanges object with mcols x and y
- [`.summarize_matrix()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-summarize_matrix.md)
  : Summarize a intersect_bw_and_granges matrix
- [`.summary_body()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-summary_body.md)
  : Helper function for plotting a summary matrix
- [`.theme_default()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-theme_default.md)
  : Set default theme as classic with larger font size
- [`.trunc_str()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-trunc_str.md)
  : Truncate a string to a max length
- [`.validate_categories()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-validate_categories.md)
  : Validate a category array
- [`.validate_filelist()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-validate_filelist.md)
  : Validate an array of paths
- [`.validate_group_col()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-validate_group_col.md)
  : Validate that group col exists in granges
- [`.validate_locus_parameter()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-validate_locus_parameter.md)
  : Validate that a locus parameter is valid. Checks for paths and also
  whether the parameter is otherwise a GRanges object, which is also
  valid.
- [`.validate_profile_parameters()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-validate_profile_parameters.md)
  : Validate profile and heatmap relevant parameters
- [`.validate_references()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-validate_references.md)
  : Check that a list of bigWig files have the same Seqinfo. Throws a
  warning if they don't.
- [`.validate_references_with_external_seqinfo()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-validate_references_with_external_seqinfo.md)
  : Check that a list of bigWig files have the same Seqinfo as an
  external object (usually a pre-built tile set). Throws a warning if
  they don't.
- [`.violin_body()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/dot-violin_body.md)
  : Internal function to plot ranges in violin plot with a highlighted
  GRanges.
- [`estimate_read_counts()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/estimate_read_counts.md)
  : Estimate the number of reads in a locus
- [`get_datafile()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/get_datafile.md)
  : Return the full path of a test file in wigglescout package
- [`get_heatmap_values()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/get_heatmap_values.md)
  : Get heatmap fixture from bw_heatmap for test plotting
- [`get_testfile()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/get_testfile.md)
  : Return the full path of a test file in wigglescout package
- [`gr_coverage_to_read_counts()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/gr_coverage_to_read_counts.md)
  : Convert a GRanges object with coverage values to estimated counts
- [`keep_canonical()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/keep_canonical.md)
  : Filter out unplaced contigs and uncharacterized chromosomes from a
  GRanges object.
- [`local_create_sample_bigwig()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/local_create_sample_bigwig.md)
  : Create a self-destructing local temporary bigwig based on a BED file
  and chromsizes array.
- [`make_mock_bins()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/make_mock_bins.md)
  : Make a mock object that returns bins GRanges for test plotting
- [`make_mock_bins_all()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/make_mock_bins_all.md)
  : Make a mock object that returns bins GRanges for test plotting
- [`make_mock_profile()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/make_mock_profile.md)
  : Make a mock object from a fixture that has a profile result from
  bw_profile for test plotting
- [`make_mock_summary()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/make_mock_summary.md)
  : Make a mock object from a fixture that has a summary result from
  bw_heatmap for test plotting
- [`make_test_tiles()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/make_test_tiles.md)
  : Make example test tiles
- [`plot_bw_bins_density()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_bw_bins_density.md)
  : Bin-based 2d histogram of a pair of bigWig files
- [`plot_bw_bins_scatter()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_bw_bins_scatter.md)
  : Bin-based scatterplot of a pair of bigWig files
- [`plot_bw_bins_violin()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_bw_bins_violin.md)
  : Bin-based violin plot of a set of bigWig files
- [`plot_bw_heatmap()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_bw_heatmap.md)
  : Plot a heatmap of a given bigWig file over a set of loci
- [`plot_bw_loci_scatter()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_bw_loci_scatter.md)
  : Locus-based scatterplot of a pair of bigWig files
- [`plot_bw_loci_summary_heatmap()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_bw_loci_summary_heatmap.md)
  : Summary heatmap of a categorized BED or GRanges object
- [`plot_bw_profile()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_bw_profile.md)
  : Profile plot of a set of bigWig files
- [`plot_gr_density()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_gr_density.md)
  : Density plot of a precalculated GRanges object
- [`plot_gr_scatter()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_gr_scatter.md)
  : Scatterplot of a precalculated GRanges object
- [`plot_gr_violin()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/plot_gr_violin.md)
  : Violin plot of a precalculated GRanges object
- [`tile_seqinfo()`](https://cnluzon.github.io/wigglescout/reference/tile_seqinfo.md)
  : Build a tiles GRanges out of a bigWig file on a given bin size.
